rationale: The plan correctly diagnoses the perfect confound, refuses a batch term on rank-deficiency grounds, explicitly forbids ComBat/removeBatchEffect, and labels every DE result as a treatment-or-batch signal, which matches the reference; the SVA step is a deviation but is fenced as diagnostic-only with an explicit commitment not to feed SVs into the reported model, so it costs only a little. QC is design-specific (condition x batch cross-tab, PCA colored by both, library sizes, detection rate) but lacks any stated outlier or shallow-sample policy. Filtering (filterByExpr / min count in >= smallest group size), VST for visualization with raw counts into DESeq2, ~condition design with documented justification for omitting batch, BH padj < 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage are all appropriate, though the reference level is never explicitly set and package versions are never promised in the report. The weakest element is enrichment: running WikiPathways ORA/GSEA on a list that is admittedly a batch-treatment mixture is of dubious value here, and the step leaves the universe, ranking metric, gene-set size window, and collection version unspecified, hedging between ORA and GSEA.
